lesen.label: Lesen
lesen.scoring: One point per item. Module points = raw x 3.33, rounded to the nearest whole point.

hoeren.label: Hören
hoeren.scoring: One point per item, same conversion as Lesen. The exam time is about 40 minutes.

schreiben.label: Schreiben

teile.label: Message to a superior, about 100 words

schreiben.scoring: Rated by raters on the official criteria; the app's essay points are an estimate.

sprechen.label: Sprechen

teile.label: All Teile together (Teil 1 talk and questions, Teil 2 discussion)

sprechen.scoring: Teil 1 talk and questions, Teil 2 discussion, Aussprache 16 across both. The split of the other 84 points per Teil was not confirmed, so practice points are entered as one total out of 84.
sprechen.verify_note: Same check as B1 Sprechen. Aussprache cannot be measured by the app.

conflicts: The old pre-modular B2 Prüfungsziele PDF (4 x 25 points) describes the retired format and is not used.
word_list_note: No official Goethe word list for B2 was found. With a B2 target the B1 list coverage is shown.
